narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -6.60 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 877.22-899.10 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 903.39; the first objective pays 0.78R at 875.19.

plan.invalidation: structure beyond 903.39 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
